title: Lehenga
description: Bespoke bridal lehengas, Pakistani cuts, draped silhouettes, and fusion couture tailored to perfection.

subcategories.title: Bridal Lehengas
subcategories.desc: Heavy, traditional, and heavily embroidered pieces meant specifically for the bride.

subcategories.title: Pakistani Lehengas
subcategories.desc: Characterized by long, flowing shirts (kurtis) paired with voluminous skirts, intricate thread work, and sheer dupattas.

subcategories.title: Draped Lehengas
subcategories.desc: Contemporary pre-draped or saree-style lehengas featuring attached pallus or cowl drapes for modern comfort.

subcategories.title: Fusion / Indo-Western Lehengas
subcategories.desc: Modern silhouettes incorporating capes, structured crop tops, jackets, or asymmetric cuts.

subcategories.title: Light / Festive Lehengas
subcategories.desc: Lighter embroidery, prints, or organza styles ideal for bridesmaids, sangeet, or mehendi guests.

subcategories.title: Reception Lehengas
subcategories.desc: Glamorous, statement-heavy pieces featuring metallic accents, sequins, or modern cuts for evening celebrations.

title: Gown
description: Red carpet ball gowns, mermaid cuts, and Indo-Western flared silhouettes engineered to stand out.

subcategories.title: Ball Gowns
subcategories.desc: Voluminous, dramatic princess-style silhouettes with heavy layering.

subcategories.title: A-Line Gowns
subcategories.desc: Fitted at the bodice and gradually flaring out to form an 'A' shape, flattering for all body types.

subcategories.title: Mermaid / Fishtail Gowns
subcategories.desc: Fitted through the body and flaring out dramatically at the knees.

subcategories.title: Indo-Western Gowns
subcategories.desc: Traditional Indian embroideries and fabrics (like georgette, silk, or tissue) tailored into Western gown silhouettes.

subcategories.title: Reception / Cocktail Gowns
subcategories.desc: Sleek, high-slit, or sequined evening wear designed for night events.

subcategories.title: Tiered / Layered Gowns
subcategories.desc: Feature cascading ruffles or multiple tiers for enhanced texture and movement.

title: Saree
description: Traditional Kanjeevarams, pre-draped ready-to-wear sarees, ruffles, and handloom silks.

subcategories.title: Bridal Sarees
subcategories.desc: Heavy Kanjeevarams, traditional heavy silks, and heavily embellished designer weaves for the main wedding day.

subcategories.title: Ruffle & Tiered Sarees
subcategories.desc: Modern trendy sarees featuring ruffled pleats or pallus for a playful, voluminous look.

subcategories.title: Pre-Draped / Ready-to-Wear Sarees
subcategories.desc: Zip-up or pre-stitched sarees that offer the elegance of a saree with the ease of a skirt.

subcategories.title: Designer / Organza Sarees
subcategories.desc: Lightweight, translucent floral-printed or embroidered organza and tissue sarees.

subcategories.title: Party Wear / Cocktail Sarees
subcategories.desc: Heavy net, shimmer, metallic, or sequin-embellished sarees for evening events.

subcategories.title: Handloom & Traditional Silks
subcategories.desc: Classic weaves like Banarasi, Chanderi, Tussar, and Gadwal for traditional elegance.

title: Party Wears
description: Anarkalis, sharara sets, palazzo suits, and embroidered capes for sangeets, mehendi & celebrations.

subcategories.title: Anarkali Suits
subcategories.desc: Floor-length or mid-length flowing flared suits paired with fitted churidars.

subcategories.title: Sharara & Gharara Sets
subcategories.desc: Short or mid-length kurtis paired with flared, ruffled pants or traditional double-flared trousers.

subcategories.title: Indo-Western Co-ord Sets
subcategories.desc: Matching contemporary crop tops with wide-leg pants, skirts, or draped dhotis.

subcategories.title: Palazzo & Pant Suits
subcategories.desc: Long straight-cut or asymmetric kurtis paired with chic palazzos or cigarette pants.

subcategories.title: Cape Sets
subcategories.desc: Elegant tunics or lehengas accompanied by sheer or heavily embellished embroidered capes.

title: Men's Wear
description: Regal sherwanis, Jodhpuri bandhgalas, Indo-Western fusion suits, and classic kurta pyjama sets.

subcategories.title: Sherwanis
subcategories.desc: Grand, structured long coats traditionally worn for weddings and grand receptions.

subcategories.title: Indo-Western Suits
subcategories.desc: Contemporary fusion wear combining traditional Indian embroidery or cuts with Western blazers and trousers.

subcategories.title: Bandhgalas (Jodhpuri Suits)
subcategories.desc: High-necked, fitted formal jackets offering a sharp, regal look.

subcategories.title: Kurta Pyjama Sets
subcategories.desc: Classic cotton, silk, or linen straight kurtas paired with churidars or pyjamas.

subcategories.title: Nehru Jackets & Waistcoats
subcategories.desc: Layering pieces worn over standard kurta sets to instantly elevate a festive or wedding outfit.

subcategories.title: Tuxedos & Formal Suits
subcategories.desc: Classic Western two-piece or three-piece suits for western-themed cocktail nights or receptions.
